name: InnerPath
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Department d INNER JOIN d/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Employee e

name: LeftPath
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Department d LEFT JOIN d/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Employee e

name: RightPath
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Department d RIGHT JOIN d/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Employee e

name: FullPath
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Department d FULL JOIN d/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Employee e

name: InnerOn
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Department d INNER JOIN Views.Employee e ON d.Name = e.DepartmentName

name: LeftOn
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Department d LEFT JOIN Views.Employee e ON d.Name = e.DepartmentName

name: FullOn
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Department d FULL JOIN Views.Employee e ON d.Name = e.DepartmentName

name: ReversePath
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Employee e LEFT JOIN e/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Department d

name: FilteredJoin
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Department d FULL OUTER JOIN d/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Employee e WHERE e.Salary > 8

name: MultipleJoins
query: SELECT e.Name AS Employee, peer.Name AS Peer FROM Views.Employee e INNER JOIN e/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Department d INNER JOIN d/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Employee peer WHERE e.Name != peer.Name

name: GroupedFull
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, COUNT(*) AS RowsCount, COUNT(e.ID) AS EmployeesCount, COUNT(e.Salary) AS SalariesCount, SUM(e.Salary) AS TotalSalary, AVG(e.Salary) AS AverageSalary, MIN(e.Salary) AS MinimumSalary, MAX(e.Salary) AS MaximumSalary, MIN(e.DateOfBirth) AS EarliestBirth, MAX(e.DateOfBirth) AS LatestBirth FROM Views.Department d FULL JOIN d/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Employee e GROUP BY d.Name

name: GlobalAggregate
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS RowsCount, COUNT(e.ID) AS EmployeesCount, COUNT(e.Salary) AS SalariesCount, SUM(e.Salary) AS TotalSalary, AVG(e.Salary) AS AverageSalary, MIN(e.Salary) AS MinimumSalary, MAX(e.Salary) AS MaximumSalary, MIN(e.DateOfBirth) AS EarliestBirth, MAX(e.DateOfBirth) AS LatestBirth FROM Views.Employee e

name: EmptyAggregate
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS RowsCount, COUNT(e.ID) AS EmployeesCount, COUNT(e.Salary) AS SalariesCount, SUM(e.Salary) AS TotalSalary, AVG(e.Salary) AS AverageSalary, MIN(e.Salary) AS MinimumSalary, MAX(e.Salary) AS MaximumSalary, MIN(e.DateOfBirth) AS EarliestBirth, MAX(e.DateOfBirth) AS LatestBirth FROM Views.Employee e WHERE e.Salary > 999999999999999999

name: EmptyGrouped
query: SELECT e.DepartmentName AS Department, COUNT(*) AS RowsCount, COUNT(e.ID) AS EmployeesCount, COUNT(e.Salary) AS SalariesCount, SUM(e.Salary) AS TotalSalary, AVG(e.Salary) AS AverageSalary, MIN(e.Salary) AS MinimumSalary, MAX(e.Salary) AS MaximumSalary, MIN(e.DateOfBirth) AS EarliestBirth, MAX(e.DateOfBirth) AS LatestBirth FROM Views.Employee e WHERE e.Salary > 999999999999999999 GROUP BY e.DepartmentName

name: NullAggregate
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS RowsCount, COUNT(e.ID) AS EmployeesCount, COUNT(e.Salary) AS SalariesCount, SUM(e.Salary) AS TotalSalary, AVG(e.Salary) AS AverageSalary, MIN(e.Salary) AS MinimumSalary, MAX(e.Salary) AS MaximumSalary, MIN(e.DateOfBirth) AS EarliestBirth, MAX(e.DateOfBirth) AS LatestBirth FROM Views.Employee e WHERE e.Salary IS NULL

name: GroupStrings
query: SELECT e.DepartmentName AS Department, MIN(e.Name) AS FirstName, MAX(e.Name) AS LastName, COUNT(*) AS RowsCount FROM Views.Employee e GROUP BY e.DepartmentName

name: RecurringAverage
query: SELECT AVG(e.Salary) AS AverageSalary FROM Views.Employee e WHERE e.Name = 'A' OR e.Name = 'E' OR e.Name = 'D'

name: PathWithOn
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee FROM Views.Department d LEFT JOIN d/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Employee e ON e.Salary > 8

name: CrossOnTrue
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS RowsCount FROM Views.Department JOIN Views.Employee AS e ON TRUE

name: UnqualifiedGroup
query: SELECT DepartmentName AS Department, MIN(Name) AS FirstName, COUNT(*) AS RowsCount FROM Views.Employee GROUP BY DepartmentName

name: GroupWithoutAggregate
query: SELECT e.DepartmentName AS Department FROM Views.Employee e GROUP BY e.DepartmentName

name: LinkedEmployee
query: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.ID AS LinkedEmployee FROM Views.Department d LEFT JOIN d/Views.Employee_Department/Views.Employee e
